'''Ghost Squad''' was an elite unit led by the independent operative [[Specter-12]], a member of the [[Specialists]]. Ghost Squad accompanied Specter-12 to [[Makeb]] with the rest of the Specialists' forces during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
